text.p: NeoTherapeutics Inc said underwriters of its recent public offering exercised their over-allotment option by purchasing 200,000 units at $7.60 each.
Each unit consists of one share of common stock and a warrant to purchase another common share.
It said the over-allotment exercise added about $1.5 million in gross proceeds, bringing total proceeds from the public offering to $20.5 million.

NeoTherapeutics is working on developing drugs to treat degenerative diseases of the nervous system, such as memory deficits associated with Alzheimer's disease, as well as the dementia resulting from aging, stroke, AIDS and spinal cord injuries.
